_comment: How the Lessons table shows the contract's values. Read by src/lessonValues.ts. status: a Badge variant per status; kind: a StatusDot variant (accent, success, warning, error, neutral) and a label per kind; polarity: a label and an optional dot variant (no dot when absent); transfer: a label. Adding an entry: key it by the contract's value, give a label, and pick a variant from the lists above; a new value of the contract also goes into the lists at the top of src/lessonValues.ts, which checks at load that every one has an entry.
